name: @activepieces/piece-canva
description: Create stunning designs with Canva's powerful design automation tools

auth.description:
To connect Canva, follow these steps:
1. Go to https://www.canva.com/developers/integrations and sign in.
2. Click **Create an integration** and fill in the app name and description.
3. Under **Configure** → **Authentication**, set the redirect URL to the one shown above.
4. Under **Configure** → **Scopes**, enable: `design:content:read`, `design:content:write`, `design:meta:read`, `asset:read`, `asset:write`, `folder:read`, `folder:write`.
5. Copy the **Client ID** and **Client secret** and paste them above.

create_design.name: create_design
create_design.description: Create a new Canva design using preset design types or custom dimensions. Blank designs are automatically deleted if not edited within 7 days.

designTypeOption.description: Choose how to create your design - preset templates or custom dimensions

presetName.description: ⚠️ Only fill this if you selected "Preset Design Type" above

customWidth.description: ⚠️ Only fill this if you selected "Custom Dimensions" above. Min: 40, Max: 8000

customHeight.description: ⚠️ Only fill this if you selected "Custom Dimensions" above. Min: 40, Max: 8000

title.description: Optional: Name for your design (1-255 characters). If empty, Canva will auto-generate a title.

assetId.description: Optional: Select an existing image asset to add to the design

aiMetadata.description: Creates a brand-new Canva design, either from a preset type (doc, whiteboard, presentation) or with custom pixel dimensions (40-8000px), optionally titled and seeded with an existing image asset. Pick this to start a fresh design; use Import Design instead when converting an existing file like a PDF or PPTX. Not idempotent: every call creates another design, and untouched blank designs are auto-deleted after 7 days.

get_design.name: get_design
get_design.description: Get the metadata for one of your designs, including owner information, URLs for editing and viewing, and thumbnail information.

designId.description: Select the design to retrieve metadata for

aiMetadata.description: Fetches metadata for a single Canva design by design ID, including owner, edit/view URLs, and thumbnail. Pick this when you already know the design ID; use Find Design first if you only have a title or keywords. Read-only and idempotent; fails with 404 if the design does not exist or is inaccessible.

upload_asset.name: upload_asset
upload_asset.description: Upload an image or video asset to your Canva library. This creates an asynchronous job that you can monitor for completion.

file.description:
📁 Supported formats:
      🖼️ Images (max 50MB): JPG, JPEG, PNG, HEIC, GIF, TIFF, WEBP
      🎬 Videos (max 500MB): M4V, MKV, MP4, MPEG, MOV, WEBM

assetName.description: 🏷️ Name for the asset (max 50 characters, supports emojis and special characters)

aiMetadata.description: Uploads an image (max 50MB) or video (max 500MB) file into the user's Canva media library via an asynchronous job, with a required asset name of at most 50 characters. Pick this to add media for later use in designs; use Import Design instead when the file should become an editable design itself. Not idempotent: each call starts a new upload and creates a duplicate asset.

import_design.name: import_design
import_design.description: Import an external file (PDF, PSD, DOCX, PPTX, etc.) into Canva as a new design. This creates an asynchronous job that you can monitor for completion.

file.description:
📄 Supported formats:
      📋 Documents: PDF, DOC, DOCX, ODT, Pages
      📊 Presentations: PPT, PPTX, ODP, Keynote  
      📈 Spreadsheets: XLS, XLSX, ODS, Numbers
      🎨 Design Files: AI (Illustrator), PSD (Photoshop), ODG

designTitle.description: 🏷️ Title for the imported design (max 50 characters, supports emojis and special characters)

autoDetectMimeType.description: ✅ Recommended: Let Canva automatically detect the file type. Uncheck to manually specify MIME type from file extension.

aiMetadata.description: Uploads an external document or design file (PDF, DOCX, PPTX, XLSX, PSD, AI, and similar) and converts it into a new Canva design via an asynchronous import job, with a required title of at most 50 characters. Pick this to bring existing files into Canva as editable designs; use Create Design for a blank design and Upload Asset for images/videos meant for the media library. Not idempotent: each call starts a new import and can create duplicate designs.

export_design.name: export_design
export_design.description: Export a Canva design to various formats (PDF, JPG, PNG, GIF, PPTX, MP4). This creates an asynchronous job with download URLs valid for 24 hours.

exportFormat.description: The format to export the design to

exportQuality.description: Export quality level (Pro quality may require premium elements license)

pages.description: Page numbers to export (leave empty to export all pages). First page is 1.

jpegQuality.description: 🎯 JPEG ONLY: Compression quality (1-100, higher = better quality, larger file)

pdfSize.description: 🎯 PDF ONLY: Paper size for PDF export (only for Canva Docs)

mp4Quality.description: 🎯 MP4 ONLY: Video orientation and resolution for MP4 export

customWidth.description: 🎯 IMAGES ONLY (JPG/PNG/GIF): Custom width (40-25000px). Leave empty for original size.

customHeight.description: 🎯 IMAGES ONLY (JPG/PNG/GIF): Custom height (40-25000px). Leave empty for original size.

pngLossless.description: 🎯 PNG ONLY: Export PNG without compression (default: true). Lossy compression requires Pro plan.

pngTransparentBackground.description: 🎯 PNG ONLY: Export PNG with transparent background (Pro feature)

pngSingleImage.description: 🎯 PNG ONLY: Merge multi-page designs into a single image (default: separate images per page)

aiMetadata.description: Starts an asynchronous export job that renders an existing Canva design as PDF, JPG, PNG, GIF, PPTX, or MP4, with format-specific options (quality, page selection, custom image dimensions, PDF paper size). Pick this when you need downloadable output files from a design; download URLs expire after 24 hours and the job may need to be polled for completion. Not idempotent: each call queues a new export job.

move_folder_item.name: move_folder_item
move_folder_item.description: Move an item from one folder to another in Canva

to_folder_id.description: Select the folder to move the item to

item_type.description: Select the type of item you want to move

item_id.description: Select the item you want to move

aiMetadata.description: Moves a design or image asset into a specified destination folder in Canva, identified by item ID and folder ID. Pick this to reorganize library content; it fails for items that currently live in multiple folders (those must be moved in the Canva UI). Effectively idempotent: repeating the same move leaves the item in the same destination folder.

find_design.name: find_design
find_design.description: Search and list designs from your Canva library. Use this to find existing designs before creating new ones.

query.description: Enter keywords to search designs by title or content (leave empty to get all designs)

ownership.description: Filter designs by who owns them

sort_by.description: How to order the search results

limit.description: Max designs to return (default: 20, max: 100). Higher numbers may be slower.

continuation.description: For pagination: token from previous search to get next page of results

aiMetadata.description: Searches the user's Canva design library by keyword, with ownership (owned/shared) and sort filters plus continuation-token pagination; an empty query lists all designs. Pick this to discover or look up design IDs before getting, exporting, or moving a design, rather than creating a duplicate. Read-only and idempotent.

get_folder.name: get_folder
get_folder.description: Retrieve metadata for a specific folder, including name, creation date, and thumbnail.

folder_id.description: Select the folder to retrieve metadata for

aiMetadata.description: Fetches metadata for a single Canva folder by folder ID, including its name, created/updated timestamps, and thumbnail. Pick this to verify a folder exists or get its details before moving items into it; it returns folder metadata only, not the folder contents. Read-only and idempotent.

get_asset.name: get_asset
get_asset.description: Retrieve metadata for a specific asset (image or video), including name, tags, creation date, and thumbnail.

asset_id.description: Select the asset to retrieve metadata for

aiMetadata.description: Fetches metadata for a single Canva library asset (image or video) by asset ID, including name, tags, timestamps, thumbnail, and import status. Pick this when you already have an asset ID and need its details or to confirm an upload finished importing; it is about library assets, not designs (use Get Design for those). Read-only and idempotent.

custom_api_call.name: custom_api_call
custom_api_call.description: Make a custom API call to a specific endpoint

1. Go to https://www.canva.com/developers/integrations and sign in.
2. Click **Create an integration** and fill in the app name and description.
3. Under **Configure** → **Authentication**, set the redirect URL to the one shown above.
4. Under **Configure** → **Scopes**, enable: `design:content:read`, `design:content:write`, `design:meta:read`, `asset:read`, `asset:write`, `folder:read`, `folder:write`.
5. Copy the **Client ID** and **Client secret** and paste them above.
